policy.application: Apply family defaults only to a previously unseen brand/scope context or explicit user reset. Saved applied criteria and saved draft always win.
policy.brandScope: Brand identity, product/format scope and industry profile version are separate context keys. Source peers retain all comparable entities; limiting the selectable Nonbank ten does not restrict comparator data.
policy.thresholdAuthority: Public operator evidence supports mission, not Yolk percentiles, supply cutoffs or weights. Do not claim operator-approved or outcome-calibrated presets.
policy.nationalQuantiles: Fixed national7954 reporting UUID universe, known valid finite nonnegative values per metric; map filters and brand changes do not recalculate cutoffs.
policy.missing: Missing is unknown, not zero. New paths use positive-presence guards; preserve accepted Fuel literalzero semantics.
policy.groceryFallback: If selected brand has no source membership in a chosen scope, show unavailable own-scope evidence, not ownSupply0. Generic family is a study view, not confirmation of membership.
policy.brandPrimaryFormat: Initial brand selection uses the suggested important format supported by brand positioning and observed source membership. Source inventory counts are disclosed as context, never financial market share. User-selected scopes and saved settings remain supported.
